terms.meaning: a named value, such as a color or spacing size, used across the app.
a color written as a hash sign followed by six letters or digits.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Setup for the design values
sections.what: A header describing this file as the app's basic design values.
sections.why: Likely reason: makes the purpose of the file clear.

sections.name: Colors (part 1)
sections.title: Brand and status colors
sections.what: Defines the indigo brand shades, accent colors for health topics, status colors from normal to critical, and the dark and light background, text and border colors.
sections.why: Likely reason: changing a color here updates every screen that uses it.
sections.watch_out: The screens shown here use the dark set. The light set exists, but nothing in this packet switches to it.

sections.name: Colors (part 2)
sections.title: Gradient color pairs
sections.what: Defines the color pairs used for gradients on buttons, health items, warnings, danger, ocean, night and glass-style cards.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps gradients consistent across the app.
sections.watch_out: Components use these as two-color pairs without checking, so a list with a different count can cause a runtime error.

sections.name: Spacing
sections.title: Spacing sizes
sections.what: Defines standard gaps and padding from extra small to very large.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps spacing consistent across screens.

sections.name: BorderRadius
sections.title: Corner roundness sizes
sections.what: Defines standard corner roundness from small to fully round.
sections.watch_out: The full size is very large, so it only looks right on square elements.

sections.name: Typography
sections.title: Text sizes and weights
sections.what: Defines the standard text sizes, font weights and line-height multipliers.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps text consistent across screens.
sections.watch_out: Weights are text values such as '700', not numbers, so plain numbers will not match.

sections.name: Shadows
sections.title: Shadow settings
sections.what: Defines small, medium and large shadows, plus a colored glow that is built from a color you pass in.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives cards and buttons consistent depth.
sections.watch_out: The glow is a function, so it must be called with a color; the other shadows are used directly.

sections.name: Animation
sections.title: Animation timings
sections.what: Defines fast, normal and slow animation times and a spring setting for a bouncy movement.
sections.watch_out: Times are in milliseconds, so 300 means 0.3 seconds.

summary: The app's design values: colors, spacing, corner roundness, text sizes, shadows and animation timings.
purpose: Gives one source for the look and feel of the app.
why: Likely reason: one place to change the look for every screen.
how: Exports groups of fixed values. Screens and components import the groups they need.
outputs: Constant values such as colors and sizes.
risks: The light color set is defined but nothing in these files uses it. Gradient lists are cast loosely in components, so changing their length can cause a runtime error.
debug: If a color looks wrong, check which group it comes from and whether a light or dark value was meant. If a shadow or spacing looks off, check the matching group.
